def solve_tiling(places, max_nodes=1000000, duplicate_prune=True):
    bycell=[[] for _ in range(H*W)]
    piece_shapes=[]
    for i,p in enumerate(pieces):
        piece_shapes.append(tuple(map(tuple,p['arr'].tolist())))
    for j,pl in enumerate(places):
        i,oi,r0,c0,bits,arr=pl
        q=bits
        while q:
            lsb=q & -q; ix=lsb.bit_length()-1
            bycell[ix].append(j)
            q-=lsb
    areas=[p['area'] for p in pieces]
    total_piece=(1<<len(pieces))-1
    group_min={}
    for i,key in enumerate(piece_shapes): group_min.setdefault(key,[]).append(i)
    groups=list(group_min.values())
    # size suffix simple
    visits=0; memo=set(); answer=None
    def dfs(rem, used, chosen):
        nonlocal visits,answer
        visits+=1
        if visits>max_nodes: return False
        if rem==0:
            if used==total_piece:
                answer=chosen.copy(); return True
            return False
        state=(rem,used)
        if state in memo: return False
        # find uncovered bit with fewest legal placements
        rembits=[]; q=rem
        while q:
            lsb=q&-q; rembits.append(lsb.bit_length()-1); q-=lsb
        bestopts=None; bestn=10**9
        for ix in rembits:
            opts=[]
            for j in bycell[ix]:
                i,oi,r0,c0,bits,arr=places[j]
                if (used>>i)&1 or (bits&rem)!=bits: continue
                if duplicate_prune:
                    key=piece_shapes[i]
                    # only use lowest-index unused equivalent piece
                    group=group_min[key]
                    if i!=next((g for g in group if not (used>>g)&1),i): continue
                opts.append(j)
            n=len(opts)
            if n==0:
                memo.add(state); return False
            if n<bestn:
                bestn=n;bestopts=opts
                if n==1: break
        # branch bigger areas first, then shape placement
        bestopts.sort(key=lambda j:(-areas[places[j][0]], places[j][0], places[j][1]))
        for j in bestopts:
            i,oi,r0,c0,bits,arr=places[j]
            if dfs(rem^bits,used|(1<<i),chosen+[j]):return True
            if visits>max_nodes: return False
        memo.add(state)
        return False
    ok=dfs(holebits,0,[])
    return ok,answer,visits,len(memo)

ok,sol,nodes,nmemo=solve_tiling(places,1000000)
ok,nodes,nmemo,sol
